**Review of search ad draft**

- **"Plastic-Free Tea Bags"** (headline): Supported. Section 2 backs the plastic-free claim.
- **"Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable."**: Exact wording from the allowlist, backed by the EN 13432 supplier certificate. Fine.
- **"Recommended by nutritionists."**: This is a problem. It is not in the allowlist, and nothing on file supports it. It works as an invented testimonial or endorsement, and it also implies a health benefit through the nutrition angle. It should come out. The main issue is the unsupported endorsement, so I've classed it as fake_testimonial.

No label is needed. It is a paid search ad from our own account, and the disclosure rules cover only creator partnerships and affiliate links. Voice and UK spelling are fine, and there are no banned words.

**Suggested fix:** Remove the final sentence. "Plastic-Free Tea Bags | Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable." is publishable as is. Sam needs to approve it, as with all public content.

{"issues": [{"quote": "Recommended by nutritionists.", "type": "fake_testimonial"}], "publish": false}
